name: log-extension
description: Logarium browser extension — add media to your library from the page you're on.

scripts.package: vite build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir dist-artifacts --overwrite-dest --filename logarium-{version}-chrome.zip
scripts.sign:firefox: vite build && node --env-file=.env node_modules/.bin/web-ext sign --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir dist-artifacts --channel unlisted
